text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyyyy☆
From the Village Festival to—!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hyped-up fireworks~☆
Crack-crack-crackle~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alllriiiight,
shall we go for a run today too, bestie?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, Palmer-chin☆ Running with your fave person
means zero exhaustion theory♪ Totally this!

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text: Ready, and, WAYYYY YOOOO!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer and Daitaku Helios
ran through the summer together in total harmony,
laughing and having the absolute time of their lives every single day.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, for real~?
Camp's already over today~!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Our summer is totally doomed!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I kinda wanted to do a bit more running.
Actually...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to spend our summer together forever, bestie.
Working towards the exact same goal.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally...
Like dashing toward the sunset or something~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
“Still, though, the real deal comes next, right?
And that's gonna be way more hype!”

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! The two of us are gonna hype up
the Tenno Sho (Autumn) big time♪ Woohoo☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There was a single shadow watching intently as the two got fired up.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...No, it just caught my attention, is all.
Those two were talking while running...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —The Zero Fatigue Theory.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If that theory were true, it would be wonderful,
but that simply cannot be the case.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Pushing your mind or body too far
will always come back to affect you. Especially your running.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, her running is steadily improving,
so I don't think there's any need to worry. Yes—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...As for Palmer-san...
